card.name: Digits inside table numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit inside a number in a dense table of values, such as a dose table, radiation dose table or range. It sits right after a table gap, a decimal point or a hyphen.

modes.label: Digit in dose tables
modes.description: Digit that starts or ends a number in a dosing or duration table, often just before a following number or a range word.

modes.description: Leading or trailing digit of a decimal in a row of organ absorbed-dose values.

card.writes: It suppresses unit words like mm, Hz, km and hours, so it keeps a unit from being predicted right after a table digit.
card.plain: It marks a digit inside a number in a crowded table, where the number is not yet finished and no unit comes next.
